_about: Inputs for tools/power_budget.py. Edit values here and re-run: python3 tools/power_budget.py. Every entry carries its source; 'estimate' means no vendor figure exists and the value should be replaced by a bench measurement.
_rail_5v_v: Boost output set by R14/R15 (240k/75k, VREF 1.212 V).
_battery_nominal_v: Cell nominal voltage, Soldered 333288 / 333290 datasheets. Used for energy (Wh) and for average battery current.
_usable_fraction: Share of rated capacity used before the TLV840 supervisor (2.9 V on VSYS) switches the load off. Rated capacity is measured down to 2.5-3.0 V at 0.2C; the last few percent below 3.0 V are lost. Estimate.
_aged_capacity_fraction: End-of-life capacity (cell datasheets: >= 80 % after the rated cycle count). Used for the conservative runtime column.
_boost_efficiency_curve: TPS61088 efficiency vs 5 V output current. TI datasheet SLVSCM8D Figure 6-2 (VIN 3.6 V, VOUT 5 V, forced PWM) minus 2 points for our ~1 MHz switching frequency and the CKST0603 inductor DCR (15.5 mOhm). Linear interpolation between points.
_path_resistance_ohm: Battery to boost input: JST-PH contacts (~2 x 10 mOhm), fuse F1 1206 3 A (~25 mOhm), BQ25606 BATFET (~20 mOhm), traces. Estimate.
_load_switch_ron_ohm: TPS22975 on-resistance at VBIAS 5 V, TI datasheet typical.
_battery_side_quiescent_ma: Currents on the battery/VSYS side while running, in addition to the boost: BQ25606 battery-only 0.058 mA (typ), MAX17048 active 0.023 mA, boost feedback divider 240k+75k at 5 V 0.016 mA, R10 1M thermostat 0.004 mA, TLV840 0.0002 mA, boost VIN quiescent (included in efficiency). Rounded up.
_off_state_ua: Battery drain with the POWER slider off and no USB. See docs/power.md, off-state budget.

loads_5v.name: ADSBee 1090 core (RP2040, receiver, sub-GHz MCU)
loads_5v.source: ADSBee 1090 datasheet 2026-05-26, Quick Specs: 120 mA Wi-Fi disabled, ~400 mA Wi-Fi enabled at 5 V

loads_5v.name: Display: XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus MCU, Wi-Fi off
loads_5v.source: estimate: ESP32-S3 dual core 160-240 MHz without radio 40-50 mA (Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet, active mode); onboard LDO passes current 1:1 from 5 V

loads_5v.name: Display: 1.47 in IPS panel and touch controller
loads_5v.source: estimate: LCD controller ~5 mA, capacitive touch ~2-3 mA; Seeed publishes no figure

loads_5v.name: Display: backlight at 100 %
loads_5v.source: estimate: 1.47 in IPS backlight, 2 white LEDs at ~15 mA; Seeed publishes no figure

loads_5v.name: Carrier: BMP581, buzzer driver idle, I2C pull-ups
loads_5v.source: BMP581 normal mode < 0.01 mA; 74LVC1G17 < 0.01 mA; display I2C pull-ups ~0.05 mA

loads_5v.name: Carrier: buzzer, average
loads_5v.source: PKMCS0909 driven 3.3 V through 150 Ohm: ~20 mA while beeping, assumed 1 % duty

gnss.via: ADSBee J4 3.3 V output (assumed linear regulator: 5 V input current = 3.3 V load current)
gnss._module: u-blox MAX-M10S data sheet UBX-20035208 R02, Table 13, GPS+GAL+GLO: tracking 7.0 + 2.3 mA (VCC + V_IO), acquisition 9.0 + 2.3 mA at 3.0 V
gnss._breakout_led_ma: SparkFun GPS-18037 power LED; PPS LED blinks only with fix. Estimate.
gnss._active_antenna_ma: Typical active GNSS antenna LNA bias at 3.3 V (open issue 9). Set 0 for a passive antenna.

charging._charger_efficiency: BQ25606 buck at 5 V in, ~3.8 V out, 1-2 A: ~90-92 % (TI datasheet efficiency curves). Estimate.
charging._cv_tail_hours_per_ah: Constant-voltage phase after the constant-current phase until termination. Rule of thumb for LiPo at 0.2-0.5C. Estimate.
charging._cc_fraction: Share of capacity delivered in the constant-current phase. Estimate.
